results.name: Uranium Energy Corp.
results.description: Uranium Energy Corp., is a uranium production, development and exploration company. The company was founded on May 16th, 2003.

results.name: UEC-Kuznetsov PJSC
results.description: UEC-Kuznetsov PJSC engages in the production and repair of aircraft gas turbine engines and liquid-propellant rocket motors. It offers motors for space launch R-7, drive gas compressor units and modular stations. The company is founded in 1912 and is headquartered in Samara, Russian Federation. Manufacture aircraft gas turbine engines.

results.name: UEC Electronics LLC
results.description: UEC Electronics LLC provides complex assembly manufacturing support and engineering services for military, aerospace, medical and commercial industry. It offers engineering design, product development, and rapid prototyping. The company was founded by Philip J. Ufkes and Rebecca Ann Ufkes in 1995 and is headquartered in Hanahan, SC. Provides complex assembly manufacturing support and engineering services.

results.name: UEC Technologies LLC
results.description: UEC Technologies LLC sells technical services worldwide to the steel, mining, chemical and related industries. The company was founded in June 6th 2002, and operates as a wholly owned subsidiary of United States Steel Corp. since inception.
